title.value: Unified gene expression signature of novel NPM1 exon 5 mutations in acute myeloid leukemia
title.justification: The title directly mentions the main focus of the paper, which is the gene expression associated with novel NPM1 exon 5 mutations in acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
title.quote: Unified gene expression signature of novel NPM1 exon 5 mutations in acute myeloid leukemia

extractions.description: This scientific paper investigates novel exon 5 mutations in the NPM1 gene within acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients. The study defines the transcriptomic profile of these mutations, showing similarities with exon 12 mutations, both leading to abnormal cytoplasmic protein localization. This research highlights the importance of identifying and characterizing rare NPM1 mutations for genetic risk assessment and therapeutic strategies in AML.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on genetic mutations and profiles in acute myeloid leukemia, which is a biomedical and healthcare-related research area. There is no direct reference to climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: NPM1 mutations can be identified using immunohisto-chemistry and flow cytometry, but sequencing-based approaches limited to 3 located exons are most commonly performed... Using the NPM1 transcriptomic profile, we identified transcriptionally similar samples carrying exon 5 (NPM1e5) mutations.

primary_category.justification: The central focus of this paper is on genetic analysis and mutation profiling in leukemia, which does not align with any predefined climate or ecological sustainable development categories.
primary_category.quote: The study is part of the Leucegene project, approved by the Research Ethics Boards of Université de Montréal, Maisonneuve-Rosemont Hospital, and the Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Ste-Justine. All 430 AML samples were collected with informed consent between 2001 and 2015 according to Quebec Leukemia Cell Bank procedures.

primary_sub_category.justification: As the paper doesn’t discuss topics related to climate or ecological sustainable development, it doesn't fit into any specific sub-category under these themes.
primary_sub_category.quote: Using this workflow, we identified 125 samples with NPM1 mutations, all located in exon 12 (NPM1e12), representing 29% (125/430) of the Leucegene cohort.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper’s primary focus is on biomedical research related to acute myeloid leukemia, including genetic mutations and transcriptomic profiling.
new_primary_category.quote: In summary, our results provide additional evidence that novel NPM1 exon 5 mutations, similar to exon 12 mutations, lead to aberrant cytoplasmic protein localization.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper focuses on analyzing genetic mutations, specifically NPM1 exon 5 mutations, in acute myeloid leukemia.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Using this workflow, we identified 125 samples with NPM1 mutations, all located in exon 12 (NPM1e12), representing 29% (125/430) of the Leucegene cohort.
